title: HeyGen launch template 01-ui-sting
what_it_does: 10.8 s square sting: logo, sign-in card, counter, nav, click, menu, endcard, cut as one camera move with a vector ledger per seam.
when_to_use: Short product sting for a feature or app intro; slots map onto any product surface.
why: Apache-2.0 composition source by HeyGen, built to be re-branded (720x720, 30 fps). Copy only index.html, README and ledger; do not copy the HeyGen logo and wordmark SVGs (NOTICE excludes brand assets from the licence). Upstream pins hyperframes 0.7.94 and gsap 3.14.2, so a render under 0.9.67 still has to be confirmed.
